summary: Russian forces struck the ArcelorMittal metallurgical plant in Kryvyi Rih, killing 2 and wounding 13, while also targeting defense enterprises in Kyiv and a refinery in Kremenchug. Two Tu-22M3 bombers were relocated from Olenya airfield to Engels, raising the threat of Kh-22/32 missile strikes in coming days. Russian units made territorial advances near Novooleksandrivka and in the Druzhkovka direction, while Ukraine faces a critical shortage of Patriot interceptor missiles.
key_points: Russian strikes hit ArcelorMittal plant in Kryvyi Rih, damaging energy and blast furnace production, killing 2 and wounding 13. (Source: @UkraineNow/83462)
Russian MoD confirmed overnight strikes on defense industry enterprises in Kyiv, a refinery in Kremenchug, and a metallurgical plant in Kryvyi Rih. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32499)
Two Tu-22M3 bombers relocated from Olenya airfield to Engels, with threat of Kh-22/32 missile use in coming days. (Source: @eRadarrua/105692)
Russian forces advanced near Novooleksandrivka per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23744)
Russian units (33rd Regiment, 150th Motorized Rifle Division) advancing in Druzhkovka direction, capturing Rayskoye, Novo Grigorovka, Novo Nikolaevka, and Petrovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)
Ukraine has nearly exhausted Patriot SAM interceptor missiles, unable to intercept ballistic missile strikes in recent massive attacks. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)
Multiple UAV groups launched from the Black Sea toward Odesa region, Mykolaiv region, and Dnipropetrovsk region targeting Pavlohrad. (Source: @eRadarrua/105676)
A civilian in Astrakhan region was killed in a nighttime UAV attack. (Source: @tass_agency/390630)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted coordinated strikes on Ukrainian industrial and logistical targets including ArcelorMittal in Kryvyi Rih (2 killed, 13 wounded), defense enterprises in Kyiv, and a refinery in Kremenchug. Two Tu-22M3 strategic bombers were relocated to Engels airfield, signaling imminent Kh-22/32 missile threat. On the ground, Russian units advanced near Novooleksandrivka and in the Druzhkovka direction, capturing multiple settlements. Ukraine faces a critical Patriot interceptor shortage while continuing drone strikes deep into Russian territory, disabling 7 of 10 Wildberries logistics centers including a 250,000 m² facility in Domodedovo.

points: Ukrainian forces are facing a critical shortage of Patriot SAM interceptor missiles, with Western media citing Ukrainian officials confirming that air defense systems have been unable to intercept ballistic missile strikes in recent weeks. In massive attacks on August 1 and 5, no more than one missile was shot down out of dozens. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

Ukraine conducted drone strikes on Russian territory, disabling 7 of 10 largest Wildberries logistics centers. The largest, a 250,000 m² warehouse in the Kaledino industrial park in Domodedovo, ceased operations following a mass drone attack on the Moscow region overnight. (Source: @UkraineNow/83465)

Former Ukrainian Foreign Minister Kuleba warned citizens to prepare for life in 'alarm - 30 seconds - explosion' mode, stating this is the current reality and he does not see it changing soon. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32501)
A mass rally in support of former Defense Minister Fedorov took place in central Kyiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32506)

Ukraine's grain exports are being blocked not only by Russia but also by European countries. Poland, Hungary, and Slovakia are concerned about a new influx of Ukrainian grain into their markets following Russian strikes on Black Sea shipping. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32498)

Ukrainian forces are increasingly using drones flying above 1 km altitude and aerostat-based complexes (Hornet and similar) to significant altitudes, saving resources on altitude gain, increasing range, and avoiding effective range of mass low-altitude interceptors and electronic warfare systems. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

Russian Armed Forces conducted systematic strikes on ports in the Greater Odessa region and Danube terminals. On August 14-15, a fuel depot in the port of Yuzhny, a patrol boat, and a warehouse of military equipment in Odessa, as well as infrastructure in Izmail, were hit. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

A new wave of fuel shortages is affecting at least 18 Russian regions including Krasnodar Krai, Orenburg Oblast, Lipetsk Oblast, Kaluga Oblast, Tula Oblast, Tambov Oblast, and Primorsky Krai. Fuel limits of 20-40 liters have been imposed, an 'odd-even' system is in place, and canister sales are prohibited. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

In Chita, Zabaykalsky Krai, a total fuel deficit has been recorded with massive queues at gas stations stretching several kilometers. Drivers are forced to wait in cars for up to two days, and the first place in queue is being sold for 35,000 rubles. Local authorities have imposed fuel limits and deployed police with volunteers to control crowds. (Source: @eRadarrua/105711)

Russian forces are conducting precision strikes on Ukrzaliznytsia locomotives: during the week, two thermal locomotives were hit in the Odessa region, one a passenger train and one a shunting locomotive. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)
A civilian in Astrakhan Oblast was killed in a nighttime UAV attack. (Source: @tass_agency/390630)

The Russian MFA states Moscow is ready for negotiations but only with external involvement, claiming Kiev is not capable of guaranteeing fulfillment of any agreements. Ukraine's proposal for a partial ceasefire in the Black Sea has been rejected as an attempt to gain respite. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

Russian units including the 33rd Regiment and 150th Motorized Rifle Division are advancing in the Druzhkovka direction. The enemy has been practically driven out of Rayskoye ('the gates to Druzhkovka'), and Novo Grigorovka, Novo Nikolaevka, and Petrovka have been captured or cleared. Successes have been reported in outlying areas of Alexevo-Drushovni, and the Kazenny Torets river has been crossed. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

Multi-story buildings in Druzhkovka are being destroyed with FABs, and there is almost no civilian population left. Fire control has been intensified over roads leading to Kramatorsk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)
DeepState map update confirms Russian advance near Novooleksandrivka. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23744)

Ukrainian Armed Forces information resources are spreading a narrative of 'liberation' of dozens of settlements in the area of responsibility of the 'Vostok' Joint Forces Command. Russian sources claim units of 'Vostok' are actually liberating settlements such as Rybalskoye and inflicting damage on Ukrainian assault and assault-desant brigades. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)
A jet UAV was detected on eastern Dnipropetrovsk region heading toward Pavlohrad. (Source: @kpszsu/73145)
Russian forces attacked Sumy with drones of various types. (Source: @eRadarrua/105681)
A jet UAV was detected in Chernihiv region between Nizhyn and Olyshivka. (Source: @eRadarrua/105700)
A UAV was detected in northern Chernihiv region, heading south. (Source: @kpszsu/73167)
A jet UAV was detected on northern Kharkiv region heading toward Bohodukhiv. (Source: @kpszsu/73109)
Four groups of UAVs were launched from the Black Sea toward southern Odesa region, with one group heading toward Hrybivka/Sanzhiyka. (Source: @eRadarrua/105676)
A jet UAV from the Black Sea was heading toward Odesa region, specifically toward Zatoka and Chornomorske. (Source: @kpszsu/73129)
In Odesa region, 3 UAVs were heading toward Bessarabske and 1 toward Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi. (Source: @eRadarrua/105688)
A UAV from the Black Sea was heading toward Mykolaiv region, specifically toward Dniprovske. (Source: @kpszsu/73132)
A jet UAV was detected on southern Kharkiv region heading toward Lozova. (Source: @kpszsu/73109)

An explosion occurred in occupied Sevastopol killing a man, reportedly a traitor to Ukraine. Pro-Kremlin channel Mash claims a woman with a backpack may have been involved in the explosion. (Source: @UkraineNow/83469)
Two Tu-22M3 bombers were relocated from Olenya airfield to Engels airfield. There is a threat of Kh-22/32 missile use from these aircraft in the coming days. (Source: @eRadarrua/105692)
Enemy tactical aviation activity was detected on the southeastern direction, with a threat of aviation weapons use for frontline regions. (Source: @kpszsu/73141)
A Spanish F-18 shot down an unknown drone over Romania that violated the country's airspace. Debris was recorded between the settlements of Beleni and Cudalbi. (Source: @UkraineNow/83464)

Russian forces are increasing production of drone interceptors but a quantitative gap remains against Ukrainian high-altitude drones. Experts note it is not rational to use expensive SAMs on mass cheap drones, and low-altitude interceptors and electronic warfare systems work poorly at high altitudes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries have caused fuel shortages in at least 18 regions. Compared to June, the crisis then affected more than two-thirds of regions and gasoline production fell by approximately 25%. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

key_developments: Russian strikes hit ArcelorMittal metallurgical plant in Kryvyi Rih, damaging energy and blast furnace production and partially halting production processes, killing 2 and wounding 13. (Source: @UkraineNow/83462)

Two Tu-22M3 strategic bombers relocated from Olenya to Engels airfield, creating imminent threat of Kh-22/32 cruise missile strikes against Ukrainian targets in coming days. (Source: @eRadarrua/105692)

Russian forces advanced near Novooleksandrivka per DeepState map update, while in the Druzhkovka direction the 33rd Regiment and 150th Motorized Rifle Division captured Rayskoye, Novo Grigorovka, Novo Nikolaevka, and Petrovka. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23744)

Ukraine has nearly exhausted Patriot SAM interceptor missiles, with air defense unable to intercept ballistic strikes in recent massive attacks including August 1 and 5, where no more than one missile was shot down out of dozens. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

Russian systematic strikes on Ukrainian ports and railways have reduced grain exports to approximately 590,000 tons in the first 12 days of August, only about 30% of required volume, with railway grain deliveries to ports decreasing by 84%. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32497)

Ukraine disabled 7 of 10 largest Wildberries logistics centers in Russia, including a 250,000 m² warehouse in Domodedovo's Kaledino industrial park, following a mass drone attack on the Moscow region. (Source: @UkraineNow/83465)

A fuel crisis in Chita, Zabaykalsky Krai has reached total deficit with gas station queues stretching several kilometers, drivers waiting up to two days, and first-place queue positions being sold for 35,000 rubles. (Source: @eRadarrua/105711)
sections.threat_assessment: The relocation of two Tu-22M3 bombers to Engels airfield signals an imminent threat of Kh-22/32 missile strikes, likely targeting Ukrainian infrastructure or port facilities. Ukraine's critical shortage of Patriot interceptor missiles severely degrades its ability to defend against ballistic missile attacks, as demonstrated by near-total interception failure during August 1 and 5 attacks. Russian advances in the Druzhkovka direction by the 33rd Regiment and 150th Motorized Rifle Division are creating conditions for pressure on the Kramatorsk-Slavyansk agglomeration. The systematic targeting of Ukrainian port and railway logistics is achieving measurable economic effects, with grain exports reduced to 30% of required volumes.
sections.regional_response: Kaja Kallas announced a large-scale sanctions package against Russia for autumn, which would increase the total number of sanctioned Russian legal and physical entities by one-third. A Spanish F-18 intercepted and shot down an unknown drone violating Romanian airspace, with debris falling between Beleni and Cudalbi, highlighting the spillover risk of the air war to NATO territory. Poland, Hungary, and Slovakia are blocking Ukrainian grain exports through the EU, compounding the economic pressure from Russian strikes on Black Sea shipping. The Russian MFA claims readiness for negotiations but only with external involvement, rejecting Ukraine's proposed Black Sea ceasefire as an attempt to gain respite.
sections.intelligence_notes: The war has definitively turned into a total war of attrition, with both sides targeting deep rear logistics and industrial infrastructure. Ukrainian high-altitude drone tactics using aerostat-based complexes above 1 km are exploiting a gap in Russian air defense, as mass low-altitude interceptors and electronic warfare systems are ineffective at those altitudes. Russian fuel shortages in 18+ regions, including a severe crisis in Chita with 35,000-ruble queue speculation, demonstrate the economic impact of Ukrainian strikes on oil refineries. The Ukrainian information operation claiming liberation of dozens of settlements in the Vostok command area appears to be a disinformation effort to create the illusion of success amid Russian advances.
